properties.name: Veles
properties.description:
Every sales team knows they need CPQ. Most dread it.

Reps build quotes in spreadsheets because their CPQ takes 20 clicks to do what should take 2. They fake inputs to get past approval gates. They pay colleagues to do their quoting for them.

We built Veles so the agent builds the quote and the rep just reviews it.

Veles is the Agentic CPQ. Conversation to contract. The agent pulls context from call transcripts, CRM data, and deal history to assemble quotes automatically. No duplicating quotes to model pricing options. No approval gates that reject work the rep already did. No six-month rollout before seeing value.

Load your product catalog and start quoting in hours. No implementation consultants. No CRM schema to configure. No training required.

Works with HubSpot, Salesforce, or no CRM at all. Native integrations with Slack, Gong, Stripe, Calendly, and Loom. Anything a rep can do in Veles, they can do through Claude or any MCP-compatible environment.

Backed by Y Combinator. Built for startups scaling from founder-led to team-led sales.

properties.name: Rocinante
properties.description:
Rocinante builds GTM foundations for founders of B2B operational and technical software, both AI-native companies and SaaS, from early traction through repeatable sales motion.

The founders we work with are technical, product, or operator-led. They built something that works. They're trying to figure out how to sell it consistently, scale it past their own relationships, and arrive at Series A or B diligence with numbers that hold up to scrutiny.

The thesis behind how we work: a founder who hasn't personally carried a quota can't hire, manage, or evaluate a sales team. You can't delegate what you don't understand. The most common failure mode we see isn't bad salespeople. It's founders who hired before they had something worth handing off.

Rocinante makes the founder dangerous first. That means a validated ICP, a playbook the founder has run themselves, a RevOps stack that answers real questions, and an outbound motion tested on real buyers. Only then do we build the machine and the team around it.

What we build, scoped to stage:
— ICP validation and micro-segment buyer personas
— Founder sales coaching and quota-carrying alongside us
— Sales playbook, call frameworks, objection library
— RevOps: CRM, email infrastructure, data model, reporting
— AI SDR and outbound agent deployment
— Hiring support for first AEs and early sales leadership
— Investor-grade GTM instrumentation for fundraising

We work primarily in three verticals: AI infrastructure and ML tooling, supply chain and logistics software, and B2B commerce infrastructure. We serve companies from $300K to $50M ARR.

We don't take healthcare clients.

If you're a technical or operator founder between $300K and $10M ARR who is carrying the sales motion yourself and want it to become repeatable, that's the right starting point.

properties.name: Aspiro
properties.description:
Most B2B SaaS founders struggle at early outbound sales. Not a surprise, since many are tech builders & selling doesn't come naturally to them. GenAI and SaaS bloat has only made it tougher.

Here are some stats from B2B SaaS:
- Only ~15% of seed companies achieve PMF
- Another ~15% somehow raise a Series A, yet never achieve PMF
- Of all B2B startups, ~10% get funded but <5% get PMF

With Aspiro, early stage B2B SaaS founders can:
- Run experiments to identify & sharpen their ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) so they can focus their sales efforts
- $ validate napkin-stage ideas to acquire their first paid customers
- Then, scale to multimillion $ founder-led B2B SaaS sales with repeatable outbound tactics
- Replace technical jargons with impactful, buyer-centric sales messaging
- Share outbound GTM progress & insights with teammates & investors to keep them in-sync

Find this relatable as an early stage B2B SaaS founder or investor? Let's chat!

Check out www.letsaspiro.com and follow our page for proven tactics, tips & cheatsheets re: founder-led outbound sales.
